newsitem.title: USA: Flagstar holders start Chapter 11 proceeds.
newsitem.headline: Flagstar holders start Chapter 11 proceeds.

text.p: Flagstar Cos Inc said Tuesday certain holders of its 10 percent convertible junior subordinated debentures due 2014 have initiated an involuntary Chapter 11 proceeding.
Flagstar said it plans to file all necessary pleadings with the bankruptcy court so it can complete its proposed financial restructuring plan in the most expeditious manner possible.
Flagstar has 20 days to respond to the court filing and will operate in the normal course throughout this period.
Flagstar said that at issue is a claim by a group of debenture holders that the class is entitled to more of the value of the newly reorganized Flagstar.
Flagstar owns and operates the Carrows, Coco's, Denny's, El Pollo Loco and Quincy's Family Steakhouse restaurant brands and is the largest franchisee of Hardee's.
